mapper.insert: INSERT INTO creations (user_id, title, type, content, excerpt, words, mood, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{type}, #{content}, #{excerpt}, #{words}, #{mood}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, type, content, excerpt, words, mood, created_at, updated_at FROM creations WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
